#
#   python3.11 -m venv /tmp/lockenv

#   /tmp/lockenv/bin/pip freeze > python/requirements-biomni.lock.txt
#   # then restore this header
#

#
#   python3.11 -m venv .venv
#   .venv/bin/pip install -r python/requirements-biomni.lock.txt

# cross-platform lock with hashes. It pins versions, which is what stops the
